topics.title: Mesopotamia: Names, Languages and Early Archaeology

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the names and successive languages of Mesopotamia across its history.
Explain how links with the Old Testament shaped early archaeology in Mesopotamia and how its focus later changed.
Identify the different environments of Iraq and the livelihoods each supported.
Explain how river silt and irrigation made the southern desert highly productive.

topics.title: The Significance of Urbanism and the Movement of Goods
topics.ncert_sections: The Significance of Urbanism; Movement of Goods into Cities

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why division of labour and social organisation are marks of urban life.
Describe what Mesopotamia lacked and how it obtained those resources through trade.
Explain why water transport was vital for the viability of city economies.

topics.title: The Development, System and Uses of Writing
topics.ncert_sections: The Development of Writing; The System of Writing; Literacy; The Uses of Writing

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why writing began in Mesopotamia and what the earliest tablets recorded.
Describe how cuneiform was written and why it was hard to master.
Analyse the extent of literacy and the uses and meanings of writing in Mesopotamia.

topics.title: Urbanisation in Southern Mesopotamia: Temples, Kings and Seals
topics.ncert_sections: Urbanisation in Southern Mesopotamia: Temples and Kings; The Seal - An Urban Artefact

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how the temple grew into the main urban institution.
Analyse how war leaders became kings and how they commanded labour.
Explain how cylinder seals were made and used in city life.

topics.title: Life in the City: Ur, Mari and Abu Salabikh
topics.ncert_sections: Life in the City; A Trading Town in a Pastoral Zone; Excavating Mesopotamian Towns

concepts.learning_objective: Describe family life and the layout of houses and streets at Ur.
Explain the relationship between herders and farmers and the prosperity of Mari.
Explain how modern excavation at Abu Salabikh recovered evidence of daily life.

topics.title: Cities in Mesopotamian Culture and the Legacy of Writing
topics.ncert_sections: Cities in Mesopotamian Culture; The Legacy of Writing; An Early Library; And, an Early Archaeologist!

concepts.learning_objective: Identify Mesopotamian achievements in mathematics, astronomy and the division of time.
Describe how Assurbanipal collected and catalogued the library at Nineveh.
Analyse how the Gilgamesh Epic and Nabonidus show Mesopotamian pride in cities and the past.
